title: Ulla, son of R' Elazar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut on Song of Songs, remez 981; Hyman calls it a scribal error and says it should read "Ulla Bira'ah," as the statement is cited in Vayikra Rabbah, end of chapter 11.[^1]

notes.text: תתקפא totals 981 by arithmetic only; שה״ש/ויק״ר are contextual work expansions, ספ״יא end of chapter 11. Neither reference is newly collated. Hyman’s ט״ס/צ״ל replaces a father-name reading with Bira’ah, retaining his correction strength without identifying a place/person. Elazar’s abbreviated title remains R'; Ulla has no separate title. The unsupported alternative expansion typographical error is not adopted.
